rust_summary: entities ticking, which a mod can stop (`native_entity_tick_pre`, `native_entity_tick_post`).
doc_summary: entities ticking, through `native_entity_tick_pre` (NeoForge's `EntityTickEvent.Pre`) and `native_entity_tick_post` (`EntityTickEvent.Post`), with the entity's id and type (`minecraft:zombie`, `minecraft:item`) and the level. Set `canceled` in the Pre and the entity doesn't tick this tick (and its Post isn't told). Told for the mobs, item entities, minecarts and boats that tick in an entity-ticking chunk, on the single player server thread and on a dedicated server; not for a player's own boat or minecart, projectiles, orbs, primed TNT, falling blocks or armor stands yet (check `kind`: later APIs add kinds). Mobs and items hear every Pre before the family's first tick and every Post after its last; minecarts and boats hear theirs around each one's tick. It runs each tick for every ticking entity, so keep it cheap. Bundles that use them need "hooks": @API:entity_tick@.
